title: Pulse Visibility & Information Survival Audit (Differential Signal Chain Analysis: C3 vs. C5)
research_lead: Joel Aniol (with ChatGPT Scientific Review & Antigravity Execution)

registration.modification_policy: Any alteration to the measurement definitions after freeze requires an explicit dated amendment.

research_context.anomaly_observed: In EXP-027, the 250ms luminance pulse in Clip C5 was completely missed across all experimental formats (VLT E3-K12 WebP, GRID128 WebP, GRID512 WebP) by blinded VLM evaluation (Sensitivity = 0.0%). At 16 FPS, frame index 44 (t = 2.75s) falls directly within the pulse window (t = 2.65s to 2.90s), confirming the event was sampled in time.
research_context.core_objective: Isolate whether the signal loss occurred physically/numerically in the signal processing chain (1080p -> 64x64 downsampling -> Gram projection -> Carrier packing -> WebP lossy compression) or perceptually/cognitively in the vision model attention layer.

hypothesis.h0_physical_extinction: The pulse signal was destroyed or submerged below quantization noise (SNR < 0 dB) during spatial downsampling, Gram normalization clipping, or WebP lossy compression.
hypothesis.h1_perceptual_attentional_failure: The pulse signal survives with measurable mathematical delta (SNR > 10 dB) across multiple stages, but falls below the visual attention or contextual salience threshold of the model.

source_data.baseline_clip: C3_full_occlusion (startX=-1.6, endX=3.2, ballZ=-0.7, linear left-to-right, full occlusion 1.02s - 1.63s, reemergence at 2.37s)
source_data.pulsed_twin_clip: C5_occlusion_with_pulse (Identical kinematics to C3; 250ms emissive luminance pulse at t=2.65s to 2.90s with sinusoidal envelope sin(pi*(t-2.65)/0.25))

measurement_stages.description: Full resolution uncompressed rendered video frames.

measurement_stages.description: Spatial downscaling pipeline matching the visual carrier input.

metrics_specification.FULL_MAE: Mean absolute pixel difference across all pixels and channels.
metrics_specification.FULL_MAX_DELTA: Maximum pixel difference across all pixels and channels.
metrics_specification.ROI_MAE: Mean absolute pixel difference within the moving ball region of interest.
metrics_specification.ROI_MAX_DELTA: Maximum pixel difference within the moving ball region of interest.
metrics_specification.C3_C5_PIXEL_EQUAL: Percentage of pixels where C3 == C5 exactly.
metrics_specification.CONTRAST_RATIO: Michelson and Weber contrast of the ball against local background in C3 vs. C5.
metrics_specification.GRAM_MODE_DELTA: Coefficient difference Delta M_k = M_k(C5) - M_k(C3) for k = 0 to 11.
metrics_specification.SATURATION_CHECK: Verification of whether projection values hit the [-35.0, +35.0] normalization clipper.

amendment_phase_b_e4_y0.rationale: ChatGPT peer-review ratified CONDITIONAL YES for Phase B: isolated empirical test of adaptive Y0 centering (Y(t) - Y0) against E3-K12 static 128 centering.
amendment_phase_b_e4_y0.invariance_requirement: P1..P11 must satisfy max abs diff < 1e-10 before carrier quantization.
amendment_phase_b_e4_y0.differential_snr_specification: SNR_diff = 10 * log10(sum(S^2) / sum(E^2)) measured on identical ROI pixels, where S = Lossless_C5 - Lossless_C3 and E = WebP_diff - Lossless_diff.
amendment_phase_b_e4_y0.safety_control_scope: Verify all 5 clips (C1..C5) to prove DC saturation elimination without distortion of kinematics or direction reversals (C4).
